grown by 61.7 percent from the previous year. According to Ömer Faruk Ergün, Senior E-Commerce Expert at the Turkish Ministry of Trade, the market expanded by roughly 15 percent in U.S. dollar terms once adjusted for currency effects. Read more
Note(s): Turkey; 2016 to 2024
